# Contributing

- Fork the repository and create a branch named `feature/<short-description>` or `fix/<short-description>`.
- Make your changes inside `source/` and confirm the solution builds without errors before opening a pull request.
- Do standardisation work on a `standardize/*` branch and leave it open for review before committing to the default branch.
- Fill in the pull request template completely, including a description of what changed and how it was tested.
- Keep one blank line maximum anywhere in a source file and strip explanatory prose comments, leaving only XML documentation comments.
- Open an issue before starting large changes so the direction can be agreed on first.
